digest.component_or_area: rebar plan-review gate, reconciler, CLI, configuration composition
propositions: Recovery of approved-but-lossy RP-02 through RP-06 decisions from janitor plan 2026-08-16 requires evidence-backed derisk research to preserve architectural intent and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities before creating implementation stories.

RP-02 BindingStore transaction semantics must define ordered exact-match retirement recovery with complete tombstone/forward/reverse identity overlap at the live-operation boundary; repeat is a no-op; ambiguity aborts.

RP-03 outbound lifecycle protocol requires singular retry ownership, maximum 3 physical wire invocations per atomic logical operation, maximum 15 seconds cumulative sleep, scoped finite-pass fuse using 3-consecutive-exhausted threshold, and distinct commit_unknown classification for write operations whose response was lost.

RP-04 configuration composition must enforce explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence with per-operation snapshots, separate secret/provider boundaries, CLI-over-environment precedence correction, and fail-closed malformed-config behavior.

RP-05 CLI routing and help discovery must normalize canonical help for every visible top-level command via package-data-backed registry before handler loading, operation composition, or config materialization.

RP-06 plan-review policy ownership requires effective applicability evaluation of activated project criteria, typed failure classification with success-only checkpoint persistence, and parity-first current-run verdict projection during structural gate cutover.
